events.title: Dance Church: Kerry Bo Berry, Soulseed, Illuminati Congo
events.description: Dance Church invites you to join us in your movement practice THIS and EVERY SUNDAY! Move through what is live, in togetherness - one body, one dance floor, one love.  This week we have SOULSEED in from Remo warming us up with dancehall! See below for more info. At 5PM the lovely KERRY BO BERRY will send us off on a musical journey.
